description: HushPinterest v0.0.7: 27 patches for Pinterest 14.39.0, which needs Android 10 or newer. New in this release: Fix push notifications, a download folder you pick yourself, Plain pin links, and Hide ads now checks inside rows of pins while Hide shopping covers store product pins. Validation: 702 runtime tests passed. All 204 patch tests passed. All 27 patches applied without forcing to Pinterest 14.39.0. Needs Morphe Manager 1.34.0 or newer. The .mpp is a patch bundle, not a Pinterest APK. Uninstall the stock app first, then sign in with your email and a Pinterest password.
